title: Implicit client handling over local client table
sapRequirement: Target client isolation, privileged cross-client paths and actual DDIC client dependency.

rootCause.explanation: The custom SQLite adapter omits implicit client filtering. No upstream defect or live SAP vulnerability was established.
rootCause.scope: Configured local adapter behavior, not SAP behavior.

note: Track-related closure capabilities are broader than this individual case; no claim of a new case-specific closure verdict.
